segments.ja273:1.1: Ko nu uddhitabhattova [udditabhattova (sī.), vaḍḍhitabhattova (syā.)], pūrahatthova brāhmaṇo;
segments.ja273:1.3: Kahaṃ nu bhikkhaṃ acari, kaṃ saddhaṃ upasaṅkami.
segments.ja273:2.3: Tvaṃ maṃ mocaya bhaddante, mutto gaccheyya pabbataṃ.
segments.ja273:3.1: Kacchapā kassapā honti, koṇḍaññā honti makkaṭā;
segments.ja273:3.3: Muñca kassapa koṇḍaññaṃ, kataṃ methunakaṃ tayāti.
